messages:
Ravi (eng-sre): quick follow-up from the Onyx postmortem. Root cause: partial route leak + asymmetric NAT on customer's on-prem edge caused session pinning to fail and triggered isolation for Dedicated pools. Need clear owners for remediation + short-term mitigations.

Mira (eng-platform): I'll own the on-prem NAT behavior test harness and a config validator to catch asymmetrical NATs. Plan: local testbed + CI job. Due 2026-04-15.

Lee (eng-runtime): I'll take the serving-layer fallback and sticky-session fix. Will add a flag `--prefer-internal-dns` and a small KV fallback so requests don't rely on peer source IP. Target PR by 2026-04-08.

Olga (customer-success): Customer wants a low-friction mitigation now: reduce connection idle timers and enable peer-deprioritization so traffic shifts away from flaky peering. I'll coordinate the change and get explicit approval.

ops-bot: maintenance scheduled: "Onyx peering mitigation" 2026-04-06T22:00:00Z - 2026-04-06T22:30:00Z (ref: #maint-180150).

Ravi (eng-sre): Action items (please add tracker links / PRs into the ticket comment):
```
- A1: Route leak detection rules (owner: Ravi) due: 2026-04-10 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3601
- A2: On-prem NAT test harness + validator (owner: Mira) due: 2026-04-15 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3602
- A3: Runtime sticky-session + KV fallback (owner: Lee) due: 2026-04-08 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3603
- A4: Interim peer-deprioritization + comms (owner: Olga) due: 2026-04-05 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-3604
```

Mira (eng-platform): uploaded initial topology validator to RD-3602. snippet of check: 
```
# simple check for asymmetrical NAT
probe_src=10.11.0.5
probe_dst=10.11.255.1
if received_src != probe_src: fail('asymmetric-nat')
```

Lee (eng-runtime): added unit test simulating NAT translation drift. failing log: 
```
[2026-03-28T14:02:12Z] conn 0x7f2a: src=10.20.3.4 translated=52.18.9.7 mismatch -> session lost
```
Linking RD-3603 once PR green.

Ravi (eng-sre): I've pushed BGP visibility rules to RD-3601 and a quick detection play: `if imported_prefix_count > baseline*1.2 then annotate-event` and added a PagerDuty rule for sudden peer routes.

Olga (customer-success): Customer signed off on the short timer change (idle reduced from 300s to 90s) and peer-deprioritization for the maintenance window. I'll send the post-maintenance summary after the window.

Mira (eng-platform): note: we'll also add a pre-deploy validator to the Dedicated onboarding flow so config rejects asymmetrical NATs. Putting the blocker label on RD-3602.

Lee (eng-runtime): one more: need a rollback artifact and doc for the maintenance. ops-bot, can you upload the rollback tar?

ops-bot: rollback artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-rollback/onyx/rollback-2026-04-06.tgz. Docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/onyx/rollback.

Ravi (eng-sre): scheduling recurring follow-up until all tickets closed: Fridays 14:00 UTC. I'll run the first check-in next Friday. If anyone needs the weekly invite, ping me.

Olga (customer-success): I'll update the customer-facing timeline and include the action item owners + expected SLAs.

Lee (eng-runtime): closing note: prioritize A4 during the window to limit customer impact, then A3, then the validators/tests. Ping me if you need a pairing session on the runtime change. :white_check_mark:
